notes: Snes9x (Super Nintendo): pkgforge-dev's sharun repackaging of Snes9x 1.63 (GTK frontend).
No fullscreen flag exists (FullscreenOnOpen in the seed does it) and no '--': ROM paths are absolute, so never taken for an option.

Snes9x does not quit when a game stops and cannot bind a button combination, so it has no pad exit: OpenGamepadUI's Exit (Guide) closes it, through its normal exit (SRAM written), no dialog. A launcher-side Select + Start may come later (user decision 2026-10-06: not R3, too easy to hit).
gui_args: Snes9x's own window (touch screen; no pad-driven UI).

LD_PRELOAD qforge-sigdefer (apps/qforge-sigdefer): Snes9x 1.63 (master too) installs S9xTerm for SIGTERM/SIGINT and runs its whole exit (S9xExit) inside the signal handler, where it crashed on every OpenGamepadUI Exit (SIGSEGV/SIGABRT, HW 2026-10-06, Pocket ACE). The shim hands that handler to GLib (g_unix_signal_add), so S9xExit runs from the main loop, as when the window is closed. sharun drops LD_PRELOAD unless SHARUN_ALLOW_LD_PRELOAD is set (HW 2026-10-10). HW 2026-10-10, Pocket ACE: shim mapped, Exit runs the full S9xExit (config + SRAM written), no crash; core dumps back on. SRAM is also safe through SaveSRAMEveryNSeconds = 1.
